fullContent:
Shilajitwadi Lauha 
 Reference: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Rajayakshma Rogadhikara 166 
 Shilajitwadi Lauha is an Ayurvedic medicine in tablet or powder form. It is used in the treatment of chronic respiratory disorders. It balances tridoshas in body. 
 Ingredients 
 10 g fine powder of each of: 
 
 Shilajatu – Asphaltum 
 Madhu – Honey 
 Shunthi – Ginger Rhizome – Zingiber officinalis 
 Maricha – Black pepper – Piper nigrum 
 Pippali – Long pepper fruit – Piper longum 
 Tapya – Makshika Bhasma – Bhasma of Copper-Iron Pyrite 
 Loha Bhasma – Bhasma prepared from Iron – 60 g 
 
 Indications 
 
 Chronic respiratory diseases 
 Tuberculosis 
 Bronchitis 
 Cough 
 Cold 
 
 Dosage 
 Take 125 – 250 mg in the morning and evening, before or after food or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor. It is given along with honey. 
 Side Effects 
 
 Take this medicine only under medical supervision. 
 Self-medication with this medicine is not advised. 
 Take this medicine in precise dose and for limited period of time, as advised by doctor. 
 Over-dosage may cause severe poisonous effect. 
 It is suitable for children, pregnant and lactating mothers. 
 Keep out of reach and sight of children. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
